projects.title: California Steel Industries, Inc. Tubular Products Web Application
projects.description:
The Tubular Products Web Application is a multifaceted application structure. The web application uses Microsoft's .Net MVC Web Application as a base with some alterations. The application spans multiple machines and multiple applications to provide instantaneous updates to users and ensure accurate data collection.

Technologies:
C++, C#, JavaScript,
Networking,
SCADA Database,
Microsoft Windows Services,
Microsoft .NET MVC
